title: Footer
line: Keep the project, branch, and work state in view.

beats.caption: The footer shows your project, branch, and work state.
Back at the prompt, ready means idle.

takeaway.title: Read the work state
takeaway.line: The footer keeps your project, branch, and mode visible.

title.text: When you switch between projects, the bottom line tells you where you are and what pi is doing.

scene.text: This session starts on the main branch of greet. Turn on plan mode and the footer says planning. Leave it again and the footer goes back to ready.

takeaway.text: Ready means pi is waiting for your next instruction. When you need proof a change works, look for the check that ran.
